title: Cloud 9 Epistemology & Ephemeralization
intent: Apply Buckminster Fuller’s ephemeralization (doing more with less) and a high-altitude epistemological stance so that knowledge and infrastructure become lighter, faster, and more capable over time.
eta_goal: Continuously reduce the mass, energy, and attention required for the same or greater useful output.
core_framing: Ephemeralization is the progressive achievement of greater performance with less material and energy.
Cloud 9 stance means maintaining sufficient altitude to see the whole system while still executing concrete next actions.
OpenRoot’s volumetric and seed approaches are concrete instances of ephemeralization.
optimized_query_patterns: How can the same useful function be achieved with significantly less mass, energy, or human attention?
What is the current heaviest step in this process and how can it be lightened?
constraints: Do not sacrifice the least among us for abstract lightness
verification_notes: Measured reduction in joules or mass per unit of useful output over successive iterations.
next_physical_or_action: Take one existing process and redesign it for at least 2× performance per unit resource.
